title: ChatMessage
description: A single message in a thread. User messages are created by clients; assistant messages are created by the system at the end of a run. At least one of content or attachments must be present; services validate this cross-field rule because OpenAPI generator support for anyOf object constraints is weak.

runId.description: Run that produced this message (user input or assistant response).

x-enumDescriptions: System-authored answer generated after a run completes.

content.description: Ordered content blocks composing the message body when present.

attachments.description: Generalized resource attachments promoted alongside a message.
